content.content:
Apply by reading the dependent and the two prerequisites as each is recorded at check time; there is nothing to run. The dependent passes only if all four criteria hold; fail on any missing element or contradiction, naming the element and, where it applies, the prerequisite.

1. Applicability. The check applies to the requirement sentence the dependent is meant to carry. Fail when the dependent carries no requirement content — placeholder, empty, or otherwise nothing that states what a discard does to the workspace of the draft it ends — naming the dependent and what is missing. An absent requirement is not a silent pass, and a well-formed sentence is not evidence that the requirement content is there.

2. License, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on: no element of the dependent contradicts that prerequisite. Read the dependent against each in turn; fail on every contradicting element, naming the element and the prerequisite it departs from. This includes the end the workspace work hangs on: no element may attach the forget, the removal or the tolerance to an act other than a discard, or give that end a landing, a node, a change, a bracket, a marker, or an undo or redo unit that the prerequisite denies.

3. Engagement: the dependent itself answers the workspace half it takes from its prerequisites, rather than merely sitting beside them. Read the dependent alone; a reviewer must be able to point to the part of its requirement that bears on each of:
   (a) the draft's jj workspace is forgotten — the end of the draft reaches the workspace jj holds and gives it up, rather than stopping at the record or at the change;
   (b) the directory the record's handle derives is removed — the end reaches the tree at that derived path and no wider path: not the namespace directory above it, not the per-user root, and no path the handle does not give;
   (c) an absence at either point is tolerated as the same discard — a draft whose workspace jj no longer holds, or whose directory is not there, is still ended, neither refused because something is missing nor reported as a success that removed what was not there.
   Fail naming each of (a), (b), (c) that the dependent does not answer. Leaving one of them to a prerequisite, to a later decision, or to silence fails this criterion even when the sentence is well-formed and non-contradictory.

4. No added rule. Where the dependent answers (a)-(c), it states no element the prerequisites do not state: an order other than the forget before the removal, a path derivation beyond the per-user root, the repository's namespace and the handle with nothing appended, a per-step absence policy, a repair of drift, a workspace created to make a reference true, a record rewritten, or a verb surface (the command, its name, flags, arguments, output, refusal wording or exit status). Fail naming the element and the prerequisite that leaves it open.

No wording and no sentence shape is fixed. The three bearings of criterion 3 are questions the requirement must answer, and a requirement that answers them in different words satisfies it. Which bearing is unanswered, and which prerequisite an element departs from, are findings the reviewer names at check time, never elements fixed in advance here.
content.rationale:
The dependent is a requirement sentence, so its content is structured; vzposmvm is prose carrying the workspace half — the forget through the seam, the removal of the directory the record's handle derives, and the tolerance of an absence at either point as the same discard — and slwvtspu is the requirement sentence carrying the end of an open draft without landing. The prose edge is the matrix's natural-to-structured cell and the requirement-sentence edge is the structured-to-structured default; both are the gate form, and the default cell is flagged for a matrix extension. Nothing runs: a reviewer reads the dependent against the two recorded prerequisites and reports each failure by element and by prerequisite.

Licence alone does not cover this use. A requirement can be non-contradictory and still not use vzposmvm: one that says nothing of the workspace, or forgets the workspace without the directory the handle derives, or removes the directory without carrying an absence through, leaves the reliance on the prerequisite unexercised, and a check that asked only for a non-empty requirement sentence would pass it. Criterion 3 therefore states the three bearings explicitly — the forget of the draft's jj workspace, the removal of the directory the record's handle derives, and the tolerance of an absence at either point as the same discard — and requires the dependent's own requirement to answer each. The bearings are read off vzposmvm's commitment, which states the three as one answer, not off the dependent's wording: the criterion fixes no sentence shape and pre-names no element of the dependent, so a rewrite that keeps what the dependent decides leaves it intact and findings name the unanswered bearing at check time.

Criterion 1 keeps a placeholder from passing vacuously, and criterion 4 keeps the requirement from buying the workspace half with a rule the prerequisites leave open — an order, a wider path, a per-step absence policy, a repair of drift, or a verb surface. Every limb is read from the two recorded nodes; no module, file, flag, command or behavior probe is required.
